subject: Crestline control-sprint: map, proof owners, and artifact gating Q&A
messages:
From: Alyssa Kim <alyssa.kim@crestline.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@crestline.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Sep 2028 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SIG questionnaire and sprint plan for control mapping

Ben —

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. Attached is our Crestline SIG questionnaire (v1) and a short scope doc that outlines the controls we need mapped back to vendor evidence. We’re running a two‑week intake sprint and need a proposed owner list, an example mapping template, and any sample artifacts (log snippets, redaction guidance) we can share with our auditors.

Main asks:
- Can Redwood provide a control map that ties each SIG control to an artifact or location (e.g., KMS configuration, audit logs)?
- Example artefacts for key controls (encryption at rest, privileged access, change control).
- Timeline and the names of Redwood SMEs we’ll work with.

We’re on a compressed schedule — kickoff ideally tomorrow or Friday. Procurement needs an intake timeline so they can unblock our legal review.

Attachments: crestline_SIG_questionnaire_v1.docx; crestline_rfi_scope.pdf

Thanks,
Alyssa Kim
Sr. Vendor Risk Manager | Crestline Financial
alyssa.kim@crestline.com
(415) 555‑0198
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Kim <alyssa.kim@crestline.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Sep 2028 16:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SIG questionnaire and sprint plan for control mapping

Alyssa —

Appreciate the materials. We can support the two‑week sprint. High level proposal:
- Kickoff: Thu 2028‑09‑14 09:00 PT (30m) — quick intake of scope and artifact locations.
- Owners: Kimberly Park (Compliance lead, control mapping), Jordan Blake (Security lead, KMS & telemetry), myself as commercial lead.
- Deliverables: control mapping spreadsheet, example artifact packet (redacted logs + README), and a 1‑page control/owner matrix for your auditors.

I’ve attached our mapping template to accelerate the intake. Could you grant our team access to a secure dropbox/Drive folder where you’ll upload the completed SIG doc and any sample artifacts? If procurement needs an NDA before sharing, here’s our docusign powerform for a mutual NDA: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abcdef-1234

P.S. HubSpot deal for tracking: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/7842

Attachments: redwood_initial_control_map_template.xlsx

Next steps: confirm kickoff, share Drive link or signed NDA, and confirm any controls you want prioritized (e.g. encryption, privileged access, network segmentation).

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
From: Alyssa Kim <alyssa.kim@crestline.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@crestline.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Sep 2028 17:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SIG questionnaire and sprint plan for control mapping

Ben / team —

Confirmed: kickoff Thu 09:00 PT. I’ve asked procurement to expedite the NDA but they gave us a short window — they asked that Redwood provide a 2‑week artifact access window and a packet manifest by EOD Friday so they can validate completeness before the audit window.

Priority controls (top 5):
1) Data encryption at rest
2) KMS key lifecycle & rotation
3) Privileged access (justification + approval flows)
4) Change control for infra and models
5) Telemetry / logging retention for inference runtime

I’ll upload the SIG doc and scope to a Drive folder by tonight and share the link. Procurement has also asked for a sample SOC2 log snippet showing the format of our audit evidence (anonymized).

Attached: crestline_rfi_scope.pdf

Alyssa
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Sep 2028 20:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: proposed control mapping and ask list (pre‑kickoff)

Ben / Jordan —

Preparing the mapping ahead of the kickoff. I populated the template with initial pointers for the top 5 controls and flagged items that will need customer evidence or deeper dives:
- Encryption at rest: point to KMS (customer keys option) vs Redwood managed keys; need to supply KMS config screenshots and key rotation policy.
- KMS proofs: key creation logs (cloud KMS event), key rotation schedule, and HSM attestations if in use.
- Privileged access: we can supply privileged access matrix (engineering roles + justifications) and an approval workflow screenshot from our IAM console.
- Change control: Gated PR process + release notes—will need redacted PRs demonstrating approvals for a sample period.
- Telemetry/logging: we can provide sample tokenized log snippets and the retention policy doc.

Attachments I’ll bring to kickoff and/or upload to the shared Drive: redwood_control_mapping_v1.xlsx; soc2_log_samples_readme.txt

Questions for kickoff:
1) Will Crestline accept redacted logs that remove PII and model inputs?
2) Do you require time‑bound access for auditors vs continuous access?
3) Any evidence redaction rules we should follow beyond the questionnaire guidance?

I’ll be on the kickoff; Jordan, can you be prepared to run the KMS/telemetry portion for 20 minutes?

—Kimberly
Compliance Lead | Redwood Inference
From: Alyssa Kim <alyssa.kim@crestline.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@crestline.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Sep 2028 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SIG questionnaire and sprint plan for control mapping

Thanks, Kimberly — that level of detail is helpful. I uploaded the Crestline packet and created a Drive folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cCrestlineArtifacts (access granted to kimberly.park@redwood.com and jordan.blake@redwood.com). Procurement signed the NDA via the DocuSign link you sent.

One area requiring clarification before we hand artifacts to auditors: our KMS team needs to know whether Redwood can provide a KMS configuration export (key metadata + rotation timestamps) or whether we should collect screenshots and system‑event logs for each key. Attached a small CSV of KMS questions from our security engineers so you can confirm what evidence you can provide: crestline_kms_questions.csv

Also — we need a manifest by EOD Friday listing the files you’ll hand over in the artifact packet and the type of redaction applied to each file.

Alyssa
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Kim <alyssa.kim@crestline.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@crestline.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Sep 2028 09:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SIG questionnaire and sprint plan for control mapping

Alyssa —

Thanks for the Drive link and confirmation. Jordan and Kimberly will run the technical walkthrough today during kickoff. Quick answers to your KMS questions:
- We can provide a configuration export for keys under Redwood managed KMS instances (metadata JSON with creation and rotation timestamps). For customer‑managed keys, we will accept screenshots and event logs from Crestline KMS exports.
- Redaction approach: we’ll provide tokenized log snippets and a redaction readme for each file (implemented by our compliance team).

We’ll upload these artifacts to the Drive folder and publish the manifest (redwood_control_mapping_v1.xlsx + soc2_log_samples_readme.txt + redwood_kms_deepdive_agenda.pdf) by EOD Friday as requested. If anything shifts with procurement/legal, please loop me in.

Ben
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
(510) 555‑0123
